name: LEWA Chemical Injection Packages (CIP)
description: Skids comply with ASME, API and ATEX as stated; high-alloy materials Incoloy, Monel, titanium and Hastelloy; drives electric/solar, compressed air, gas or diesel. A 4 MB English product brochure PDF is linked on the page but was NOT fetched.

specifications.basis: Our portfolio includes systems featuring a flow rate between 5 ml/h and 180 m3/h at discharge pressure levels of up to 3500 bar
With diaphragm pumps, the system is able to operate pressure levels of up to 1200 bar.
Plunger pumps, meanwhile, enable discharge pressure levels of as much as 3500 bar to be achieved.
The injection system can store a maximum volume of 50 m3.
Up to a pressure of 20,000 psi, we use tubing for the supply and the outflow of liquids if required.
The metering pumps used in our Chemical Injection Packages are all API 675-compliant and our plunger pumps all meet API 674 standards.
